verdict.rationale: A public pricing page exists at paperspace.com/pricing, but the cited spans from it only describe Gradient and a free account. No evidence shows published per-GPU-hour rates for each GPU type. Marketing claims like "Save up to 70%" and community remarks about an hourly rate or the $9/mo Pro tier do not establish a public per-GPU-hour price list, so this applicable axis is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can see the published per-GPU-hour price for every GPU type on a public pricing page without talking to sales
